title: HOLO✦PAD
problem: Exploring how 3D creation and spatial interaction can move beyond flat screens while remaining accessible in the browser.
solution: A browser-native spatial interface where uploaded images become textured GLB holograms through SAM segmentation and extrusion, alongside a Creative Space voxel editor, hand tracking, AR/passthrough, spatial audio, and the MEG AI companion.
keyDecisions: Use React, Vite, Three.js, and React Three Fiber for real-time 3D rendering in the browser.
Use SAM segmentation and mathematical extrusion to turn uploaded images into textured GLB holograms.
Combine Creative Space voxel editing, MediaPipe Hands, AR/passthrough, and Howler.js spatial audio for hands-first interaction.

outcome.after: Owner README documents a prototype with image-to-hologram, voxel editing, hand tracking, AR/passthrough, spatial audio, and an AI companion; adoption and user outcomes are not reported.

title: QVANTA
subtitle: 3D Quantum Learning SaaS
problem: Quantum computing is difficult to see and understand; learners need an interactive way to build circuits, simulate them, and connect theory with execution.
solution: A 3D quantum learning SaaS combining circuit building, Qiskit Aer simulation, Monaco Qiskit editing, Bloch-sphere visualizations, a virtual human tutor, and multi-tenant authentication and billing.
keyDecisions: Render quantum circuits as interactive 3D scenes with React Three Fiber and Three.js.
Use FastAPI and Qiskit Aer for simulation, with a Monaco Qiskit editor and Bloch-sphere visualizations.
Structure the product as a multi-tenant SaaS with role-based authentication and tiered billing.

outcome.after: Owner README describes a multi-tenant 3D learning SaaS and identifies Team Code Busters as an SIH 2026 finalist; learner adoption and performance metrics are not reported.

title: Sketchify
problem: People need a simple way to turn ordinary photos into pencil-style sketches.
solution: A React and Tailwind frontend uploads a photo to a Flask/Python backend, where U²-Net with PyTorch and ONNX Runtime plus OpenCV/scikit-image produces a pencil rendering; the repository includes Render deployment configuration.
keyDecisions: Keep the primary flow focused on uploading a photo and receiving a pencil sketch.
Separate the React/Tailwind client from the Flask/Python image-processing API.
Combine U²-Net inference with PyTorch/ONNX Runtime and OpenCV/scikit-image pencil rendering.

outcome.after: Owner README documents an upload-to-pencil-sketch flow and Render deployment configuration; usage, adoption, and image-quality metrics are not reported.

title: Saathi / Samvaad
problem: Students may need accessible, multilingual conversational support in college environments.
solution: A multilingual chatbot concept designed for college settings, with a retrieval and language-model pipeline to ground responses in relevant information.
keyDecisions: Explore retrieval-based responses rather than relying entirely on free-form generation.
Separate retrieval, language understanding, and response generation into distinct stages.

outcome.after: Project concept and architecture documented; deployment, adoption, and user-impact numbers remain unverified.
